origin.description: Set element names. Alias of names<-.

arguments.name: value
arguments.text: Names in order. A shorter vector is padded with missing names. A longer vector is an error. NULL clears the names.

origin.details: Names stay aligned with the values. A single string names only the first element and leaves the rest unnamed.
origin.value: The same values with the new names.
